gzip.title: Check upstream request compression
gzip.desc: Sends one minimal request to the selected provider to determine whether it accepts a compressed request body. This request calls the upstream and may incur a small fee.
gzip.association_help: The check borrows the model name and custom headers from one model association. The result is stored at the provider level and does not vary by model.
gzip.no_association: This provider has no model association, so it cannot be checked. Add an association on the model association page first.
gzip.last_success: Last successful request for this association: {{time}}

status.supported_help: The model provider (upstream) accepted the compressed request body. You can enable “Allow request compression for this provider” on the provider page.
status.unsupported_help: The model provider (upstream) rejected the compressed request body. Requests remain uncompressed and normal calls are not affected.
status.inconclusive_help: This check could not confirm whether the model provider (upstream) supports compression. The cause may be credentials, rate limiting, network, or a provider failure. Try again later; compression remains disabled until confirmed.
status.unknown_help: No check has been run. This provider remains uncompressed.

gzip.detail_help: Shows the network status code and a summary of the upstream response. Request headers and keys are not stored.
gzip.provider_switch: Allow request compression for this provider
gzip.provider_switch_help: Available only when the check result is “Supported”. It also requires “Enable transport compression” and “Compress upstream requests” on the settings page.
gzip.provider_switch_note: Available only when the check result is “Supported”.
gzip.master_off: The master switch on the settings page is off. Checks still work, but compression will not take effect.
gzip.probe_failed: Check did not complete: {{message}}. This provider remains uncompressed.

toast.enable_success: Request compression enabled for this provider
toast.disable_success: Request compression disabled for this provider
